answer: Mark this, good audience: a crown bought wholesale is no crown at all. Each player must earn one opal, cut unique, locked to a single name — no wholesaler sells ten. Trust climbs a spiral: fourteen true deeds, line by line as a sonnet, each deed doubling the weight of the last — one deed weighs one, fourteen weigh 8,192. Ten masks pay ten opal bonds yet weigh ten thin voices against one true player's 8,192. One honest player, fourteen lines true, keeps the wage his own work earned.
